question: en qué países se aprueban más pagos
sql: SELECT ref_country.country_name, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM fact_payment_attempt JOIN dim_merchant ON fact_payment_attempt.merchant_sk = dim_merchant.merchant_sk JOIN dim_date ON fact_payment_attempt.event_date = dim_date.date_key JOIN ref_country ON dim_merchant.country_code = ref_country.country_code WHERE fact_payment_attempt.auth_status = 'approved' GROUP BY ref_country.country_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 10
